result.summary: No critical visual failure is present, but the selected category does not match the displayed content, and several horizontal items are clipped awkwardly at the right edge.

issues.description: The “Pizza” filter is visibly selected, but prominent results include poké, burgers, and ramen, making the page appear unfiltered or internally inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Update the restaurant sections to show pizza-related results when the Pizza chip is active, or remove the active state if these are intended to be general recommendations.

issues.description: The category row and “Fastest near you” carousel show partially cut-off items at the right edge, including an almost empty chip sliver and a truncated restaurant card/name. The clipping looks accidental rather than like a clear scrolling affordance.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card and chip widths, spacing, and right-side padding so the next item has an intentional, consistent preview or is fully hidden.
